message.content:
Let the lower line be \(y=0\) and the upper line be \(y=12\). The center of the full circle of radius \(8\) stays \(8\) cm above the lower line.

When the semicircle touches the upper line, the rising endpoint of the diameter is \(12-8=4\) cm above the center. Thus, if the rolling angle is \(\theta\),

\[
8\sin\theta=4 \implies \sin\theta=\frac12 \implies \theta=\frac{\pi}{6}.
\]

For a roll to the right, the center moves horizontally \(8\theta\). The rising endpoint is \(8\cos\theta\) to the left of the center, so its horizontal coordinate is

\[
8\theta-8\cos\theta.
\]

By symmetry, the other contact point is at the negative of this value. Therefore the distance between the two contact points is

\[
2\left(8\cos\theta-8\theta\right)
=16\left(\cos\frac{\pi}{6}-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)
=16\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)
=8\sqrt3-\frac{8\pi}{3}\text{ cm}.
\]

Numerically,

\[
8\sqrt3-\frac{8\pi}{3}\approx 5.478826\text{ cm}
=54.78826\text{ mm}.
\]

Rounded to the nearest whole millimetre, this is \(55\) mm.

The answer is 55.
